description:
Make a built-in validation gate evaluation decode each issue of its captured image once, so validation reads the issue records the evaluation already decoded.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs` ~136 and ~159: `SharedValidation` builds `CapturedValidation::with_config`, which reloads every issue (`load_issues`, `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs` ~83), after the explicit evaluation decoded the evaluated issue from the same final image (~1121). Automatic prechecks decode their final image at `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs` ~3186 and reload it during validation execution.
- Story `d675102c` sol re-checkpoint r3 (commit `f56763036`), finding 1. Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): one source of decoded records per image. If `6a19e93f`'s shared parsed records (the session's decoded issue set behind `IdIndex`) exist for the image on this path, both the evaluation's issue binding and `CapturedValidation` read from that set and nothing is added; otherwise `CapturedValidation` is seeded with the records the binding decoded and decodes only the rest. No cache, no `OnceLock`; a second binding path is ruled out.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-12.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A built-in validation gate evaluation, manual or automatic precheck, decodes each issue of its captured image once; the evaluation's issue binding and its validation read one set of decoded records.
- [hard] REQ-02: `test_gate_evaluation_resolves_its_inputs_once_per_captured_image` is extended with a built-in validation gate for a manual evaluation and a precheck, counting at the per-issue decode point; it fails on the parent commit. No new test file.
- [hard] REQ-03: Validation findings, gate verdicts and recorded evidence are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: The worker's report lists every gate evaluation input (issue, registry, gate definition, documents, validation records) with its per-image resolution count on a manual evaluation and a precheck, and none exceeds one.
title: A built-in validation gate evaluation decodes each issue once per captured image
